title: International Residential Code 2021
disclaimer: An encoded subset of the IRC, covering room dimensions, light and ventilation, egress and stair geometry for one- and two-family dwellings. Structural, energy, electrical, plumbing and mechanical provisions are not encoded. Adopting states and municipalities amend the IRC.

rules.title: Habitable room area
rules.message: {name} is {area_m2} m²; §R304.1 requires 6.5 m² (70 sq ft).
rules.note: Kitchens are exempt from the 70 sq ft floor area requirement.

rules.title: Habitable room least dimension
rules.message: {name} is {width_mm} mm across; §R304.2 requires 2134 mm (7 ft) in any horizontal direction.

rules.title: Ceiling height
rules.message: {name} has about {clear_height_mm} mm clear; §R305.1 requires 2134 mm (7 ft).

rules.title: Natural light
rules.message: {name} is glazed to {glazing_ratio} of its floor area; §R303.1 requires 8%.
rules.note: Natural ventilation is a separate requirement of the same section and is checked by irc.ventilation.natural.

rules.title: Natural ventilation
rules.message: {name} has an estimated openable area of {openable_ratio} of its floor area; §R303.1 requires 4%.
rules.note: Openable area is estimated as a fraction of the glazed area -- see the assumptions -- because the model carries window sizes, not opening lights. §R303.1 Exception 1 accepts an approved mechanical ventilation system instead of openable glazing, and no mechanical system is modelled, so a failure here is a finding against the drawing as it stands rather than proof the dwelling cannot comply.
rules.inconclusive_reason: {name} does not reach 4% openable area naturally. For a wet room that is not a finding: §R303.3 is satisfied by glazing OR by a mechanical exhaust to the outdoors, and the model carries windows, not fans, ducts or flow rates -- so the other route was never looked at. This is NOT a pass. An unventilated bathroom is a defect and a wet one is a mould problem. Confirm the exhaust against the mechanical specification.

rules.title: Required egress door
rules.message: The egress door gives {clear_width_mm} mm clear and {height_mm} mm high; §R311.2 requires 813 mm (32 in) and 1981 mm (78 in).

rules.title: Emergency escape opening from sleeping rooms
rules.assert: area_m2 >= 0.53 and width_mm >= 508 and height_mm >= 610 and sill_mm <= 1118
rules.message: A bedroom window gives {area_m2} m² clear, {width_mm}x{height_mm} mm, sill at {sill_mm} mm; §R310.1 requires 0.53 m² net clear, at least 508 mm wide and 610 mm high, with the sill no higher than 1118 mm.
rules.note: R310.1 permits 0.46 m² (5 sq ft) for a grade-floor opening. The net clear opening is smaller than the frame; verify against the window schedule.

rules.title: Stairway width
rules.message: The stair is {width_mm} mm wide; §R311.7.1 requires 914 mm (36 in).

rules.title: Riser height
rules.message: The riser is {riser_mm} mm; §R311.7.5.1 caps it at 197 mm (7 3/4 in).

rules.title: Tread depth
rules.message: The tread is {going_mm} mm; §R311.7.5.2 requires 254 mm (10 in).

rules.title: Stairway headroom
rules.message: Headroom is {headroom_mm} mm; §R311.7.2 requires 2032 mm (6 ft 8 in).

rules.title: Hallway width
rules.message: {name} is {width_mm} mm wide; §R311.6 requires 914 mm (3 ft).
